assumptions.entry: Direction change in indicated direction, next observed trade tick
assumptions.exit: First subsequent TrendOvershootExtended in position direction, next observed trade tick
assumptions.hold: Ignore further DC while holding; an overshoot in a later same-direction excursion also exits
assumptions.reverse: Opposite DC closes and reverses at next observed tick
assumptions.session: 03:00 <= entry <15:45 New York; flatten at15:45 using last price observable at/before cutoff
assumptions.risk: No protective stop, no DC-return exit; one position; no fees, quote spread or latency
